title: Publish hospital and payer MRF directory profiles
objective: MRFs become discoverable products with useful sample and access metadata.
outcome: A profile can explain a blocked file without claiming a sample exists. Separate files/releases retain stable identities. A query for negotiated rate files does not lead with enforcement outcomes as a compatible file. Counts represent hospitals/reporting entities/files separately; shared files do not inflate provider coverage. An MRF sample is not a complete hospital or payer publication. Sealed search lifecycle and coverage accounting are not edited. Last-good generation live-2026-09-03-85b50522b420 is unchanged.

commits.subject: Create versioned MRF product profiles
commits.instructions: Include entity, release, file types, locator, size, schema support, tested state, sample scope and price caveats. Reuse source-card/evidence contracts.
commits.verification: A profile can explain a blocked file without claiming a sample exists; separate files/releases retain stable identities.

commits.subject: Index pricing-specific discovery dimensions
commits.instructions: Support hospital versus payer, geography supported by evidence, file/schema version, tested availability and code/rate types. Keep uncertain facility mappings out of exact filters.
commits.verification: A query for negotiated rate files does not lead with enforcement outcomes as a compatible file.

commits.subject: Publish reconciled MRF coverage
commits.instructions: Add cohort denominators and source-profile links to the public generation. Validate each record’s sample/locator/context references.
commits.verification: Counts represent hospitals/reporting entities/files separately; shared files do not inflate provider coverage.
